figure_candidates.label: Figure 1
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 1
TENS AlphaFold2 structure prediction (red = Y2353, yellow = sbh, blue = NADPH, pink = 20-methylacetoacetyl pantetheine, orange =
LRD motif (L2296–D2298), dark red = NADPH binding residues (2214–2220, S2239, R2240, N2241, D2265, K2316, S2339, N2357, V2382)): (A)
TENS KR domain; (B) KR domain active site interaction with docked substrate and cofactor; (C) active site pocket surface view; (D) sequence
alignment of TENS, DMBS, and MILS in the substrate binding helix region; (E) visualisation of amino acids of the substrate binding helix in direction
towards the substrate (violet); (F) substrate model 4 placement relative to NADPH that would result in B-type keto-reduction.
